title: HADS 4.7.0-rc3: evidence-driven investigation and scoped repair launch
body:
## Implemented
- Fresh Core state, Recorder/device/battery/signal read-only tools; system/addon log tails, container RAM history and lifecycle evidence.
- Iterative AI evidence readbacks with persistent receipts visible in incident detail; explicit omissions and bounded context.
- Reviewable advice/questions without trusting a model's verified flag; failed repair follow-up without blind replay; no phone rename by string similarity alone.
- Explicit approve-and-start endpoint/button scoped to one plan; batch IDs frozen at launch.
- Optional Core companion for independent OneDrive download/SHA-256 verification, exact service discovery and HA service_response handling. Recorder rescue includes consistent SQLite snapshot.

## Validation
181 offline tests passed, no skips/failures. Python compile, JavaScript syntax, WebMCP contract, unique YAML keys, source/archive/installer identity and companion package checked. See outputs/HADS4_4.7.0-rc3-verification.json.

## Not a stable release
No live HAOS install, Core companion setup/cloud readback, paid API call, Docker target build or restore test performed. Companion requires separate explicit installation. Full cloud-backup orchestration/rotation, per-process telemetry and universal positive functional verification remain incomplete. Do not equate API success or quiet logs with a repaired physical system.

Stacked on RC2; does not modify main. No user logs, databases or keys are included.
